tags: Together we can curb the outdoor and feral cat overpopulation crisis. There’s a ton of outdated information out there regarding management of feral and community colonies. I’m a WEALTH of information and knowledge, as I’ve been in the game for around 4-5 years and have seen the ins and outs and the proof that it works. Hit me up if you have questions, or you’d like to start helping in your communities, but you’re not sure where to start. It’s hard. It’s taxing. It’s emotionally exhausting. And most days I don’t want to wake up, but I do. For them. They make it worth seeing the sunshine each morning. #tnvr #tnvrsaveslives #communitycatsmatter #feralcatsmatter
